ISS-ACCESS.issue_name: Cannot log in or access account
ISS-ACCESS.summary: Many reviewers say they cannot log in, including with phone number, or get OTP codes, and some are logged out unexpectedly or see login failures after uninstalling. Some say the app stopped working or that they cannot create an account.

ISS-BILLING.summary: Reviewers say basic features such as choosing songs, replaying tracks, shuffle, forward, and queuing now require premium. Several say the app should be paid only or that premium is being pushed too hard.

ISS-CATALOG.summary: Reviewers report lyrics that do not show or load for some songs, and songs or whole catalogs that are unavailable or removed. Some also say search and playback pick the wrong or unrelated songs.

ISS-DOWNLOADS.summary: Reviewers say downloads do not work, cannot be made, or cannot be played offline, and downloaded music or podcasts re-download or disappear. Some say downloading requires premium.

ISS-OTHER.issue_name: General negative rating, no specific cause
ISS-OTHER.summary: Most reviews are broad insults or general dissatisfaction with the app or recent updates, with no specific problem named. A few mention switching to another service or dislike of company or policy.

ISS-PLAYBACK.summary: Reviewers report the app crashing, pausing or stopping mid-song, failing to load or play playlists, and playing random songs instead of the chosen one. Some say it stops when the phone is locked or on certain connections.

ISS-SUPPORT.summary: Reviewers say support is unhelpful or unresponsive, with no way to reach help, slow or missing replies, and unresolved technical problems. Some also mention login problems and billing mistakes handled poorly.

ISS-USABILITY.issue_name: Too many ads and shuffle or skip problems
ISS-USABILITY.summary: Reviewers complain about frequent ads, including long runs of ads in a row, and about limited controls. Common issues include shuffle playing the wrong songs, limited skipping or rewinding, and queue problems.
